title: Posted Notice: Recovering the Freight Differential on Loads Received Away From the Contracted Facility
content:
The freight differential on Grain Marketing Contracts is recovered on the net bushels of the loads the member directed to the contract at the scale and received at a facility other than the one the contract calls for, and it is taken off the money released on the statement.

- Where two or more such loads stand and the bushels they carry reach 2500 bushels, the differential is recovered at the per-bushel differential the member's marketing programme carries.
- Where one such load stands, or the bushels they carry fall short of that floor, the differential is recovered at the half differential rate of 0.0225 per bushel.
- Where no load was received elsewhere, no freight differential is recovered.

## Which loads are counted

Only the loads the member directed to the contract at the scale are counted here, and of those only the ones received at a facility other than the one the contract calls for. A load the member ran straight through to the buyer is not a load directed to the contract at the scale, and carries no freight differential on this recovery.

## Both sides of the floor

Two such loads carrying 2500 net bushels between them reach the floor, the figure itself qualifying, and the full per-bushel differential of the marketing programme is recovered on those bushels. Two such loads carrying 2,499 bushels between them fall short and are recovered at 0.0225. A single such load, however large, is recovered at 0.0225, because one load is not two.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

Three loads directed to the contract at the scale and received elsewhere carry 4,000 net bushels between them, and the member's marketing programme carries a per-bushel differential of 0.045. The differential recovered is 180.00. Had those same bushels arrived on one such load, the recovery would be at 0.0225, being 90.00.
